model: FT-3000 series (FT-3200) inline electromagnetic flow meter, BACnet MS/TP
applies_to: ONICON FT-3000 series inline electromagnetic flow meters with the BACnet MS/TP output (PICS model FT-32**-*****-21**).
summary: The FT-3000 series mag meter has a native BACnet MS/TP port. It exposes flow rate (and percent of scale), board temperatures and battery charge as Analog Inputs, forward and reverse total and partial volumes as both Analog Values and Positive Integer Values, a reset BV, a battery-state MSV and two BitString alarm words.
default_device_instance: 4194303 (not initialized; must be set before use)
notes: Units follow the meter's configured volume and flow units; the supplement lists the supported BACnet unit codes (metric and US, per second/minute/hour/day).
MEA_ERROR and SYS_ERROR are BitString Value objects (listed as type Other); the bit meanings are in the states column.
RST_SEL_CNT acts like a strobe: writing Active resets the selected counters, and the device clears the priority array so it always reads Inactive.
Analog Input Present_Value and Reliability are writable only for testing on non-MID meters with Out_Of_Service set.
A Network Port object (NP MS/TP, instance 0) is also present.
Source: FT-3000 Series BACnet Supplement DOC-0007832 Rev.A, section 2.2.

source.title: FT-3000 Series Inline Electromagnetic Flow Meter BACnet Supplement

integration.summary: In menu 8-Communication set the MAC address, baud, Max Master and a device instance (it ships as 4194303, not initialized). Read flow rate, the forward total volume and the alarm bitstrings; write RST_SEL_CNT only to reset the selected partial counters.

minimum_points.name: MEA_ERROR
minimum_points.why: Measurement alarm bits (empty pipe, flow limits)

setup: Settings are in menu 8-Communication, behind the programming access code.
MAC 0-127 = MS/TP master, 128-254 = slave; baud 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600 or 76800; field-settable 120 ohm termination (switches 1 and 2).
Device instance ships as 4194303 ('not initialized'); set 1-4,194,302 before use. Once changed it cannot be set back to 4194303.
Bnet W.E. controls whether the device instance, name, location and description can be written over BACnet.
gotchas: The meter does not take part properly until the device instance is changed from 4194303.
Volumes appear twice (AV as REAL and PIV as integer counter); pick one type and map it consistently.
RST_SEL_CNT always reads Inactive; it is a reset strobe, not a state.

points.name: FLOW_RATE_(PC)
points.description: Flow rate as % of full scale

points.name: MEA_ERROR
points.states: bit 0 overflow, 1 pulse 1 overflow, 2 pulse 2 overflow, 3 flow min, 4 flow max, 5 signal error, 6 excitation error, 7 empty pipe

points.name: SYS_ERROR
points.states: bit 0 battery fault, 1 low battery, 2 over temperature, 3 power fail
